# P02 · Simulated block, grouping, mentors, statistics — tasks

**Goal (3 lines):** A deterministic synthetic block (40 schools, 120 Grade 3 classes, two terms, planted effects) generated at child level but stored as class counts only. Code that assigns tracks, splits the waitlist, forms cohorts, picks mentors and evaluates tracks at block and pilot scale. Eval 8 (statistics) passes and the demo data yields SUB-SFL v1 working and SUB-NODEC v1 not working from the evaluation code itself.

**Read:** design Grouping, Comparison group, Mentor selection, Evaluation, Demo data; pilot-test-pack Measuring impact; CLAUDE.md §5.
